brief: Thumbnail-size photorealistic picture of John standing in front of his greenhouse.
format: Square standalone photograph; no book-page placement.
camera_and_date_assumptions: Eye-level modest oblique view in front of the real home greenhouse, based on the H33 exterior and May doorway evidence. Soft bright daylight; no specific capture date claimed.

generation_request.prompt: Create ONE square, truly photorealistic photographic portrait for a small thumbnail illustration in The Vegetable Guru. The subject is the real man in the supplied reference photographs, the user John Lennon, a Cornish gardener, NOT the musician. Preserve his actual identity, age, natural complexion, high receding hairline with short grey-brown hair at the sides, forehead, eyes, nose, facial proportions and close grey beard. Do not idealise, de-age, smooth his skin, thicken his hair, exaggerate his jaw or add a projecting round beard. Reference 1 is the close frontal face: it is authoritative for his facial identity. Reference 2 is his actual greenhouse exterior: it is authoritative for the greenhouse, weathered silver aluminium glazing bars, clear glass, pitched roof, low masonry base, pale blue shed and pale gate. References 3 and 4 show John and the interior of this same real greenhouse; use them for his natural build and clothing and to verify the doorway, paved aisle, planting and scale. Dress him in his everyday dark/white/muted burgundy checked overshirt over a plain charcoal T-shirt and blue jeans, as photographed, sleeves loosely rolled. Bareheaded, no apron, no microphone. Show him standing OUTSIDE, immediately in front of the greenhouse entrance, comfortably upright with a gentle, natural closed-mouth smile, looking at the camera, arms resting casually. He must clearly be in front of the glasshouse, not deep inside it. Frame from about mid-thigh upwards for a readable small thumbnail; retain enough of the real greenhouse roof, doorway and glazed side behind him to identify the location. Use an eye-level camera and a modest oblique view consistent with the exterior source, with John slightly left of centre and greenhouse extending to the right. Keep natural modest garden clutter and varied real crops but avoid competing foreground objects. Accurate human-to-door scale, physically consistent glass reflections and perspective. Soft bright daylight, natural skin colour, crisp eyes, understated contrast, realistic fabric and weathered metal. Documentary-quality garden photograph, not a painting, illustration, CGI or glamorous studio portrait. Mild background separation only, so greenhouse geometry remains readable. Square 1:1 composition, no text, lettering, watermark, border, collage or graphic effects. This is one standalone new proposal image.

review: Generated image inspected against the frontal face reference, checked-shirt outfit and greenhouse exterior. Presented to John as a proposal. No user approval or print placement yet.
preservation: Ordered PDFs, approved artwork and editable masters untouched.
